title: Test Configuration
description: How to run tests - flows through all agents

runners.description: Test runner configurations keyed by runner_id

command.description: Full invocation including wrapper and runner

failure_exit_codes.description: Exit codes that count as RED. Default [1]

selector_template.description: Argument words that select one test, in place of its file. {test_file} and {test_function} are filled in, and {test_function} is required, for example ["{test_file}::{test_function}"] for pytest. A word is passed as it is, with no shell and no regex escaping, so a name-pattern runner needs anchors of its own. RED and GREEN refuse a runner with none

timeout_seconds.description: pb test kills the process group after this long. Default 540

default_runner.description: Runner ID to use when not specified
